subject.title: fix(ui): show config path in overview snapshot (Fixes #53958)

question: Should OpenClaw surface the active config path in the Overview snapshot card, move the same existing field to Settings/Config, or keep config-path discovery out of the UI?
rationale: The technical patch is narrow, but the linked request leaves the UI location open and the change makes an absolute local path prominent in a user-facing page.

options.title: Accept Overview Row
options.body: Land this display-only approach after a conflict refresh and real running-Control-UI proof show the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

options.title: Move To Settings Or Config
options.body: Ask for the same existing `configPath` field to be surfaced in a less prominent settings/config information area instead of Overview.

options.title: Keep CLI Only
options.body: Decline UI exposure and rely on existing CLI/config troubleshooting surfaces for path discovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Overview Row
recommendation.body: Land this display-only approach after a conflict refresh and real running-Control-UI proof show the admin-scoped snapshot field renders correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent current-main Overview page layout touched by this PR, making them the best available routing owner for the placement decision.
